text.formatted:
The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

|   Warlock Level | Spells                                                            |
|-----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|               3 | Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion |
|               5 | Fireball, Stinking Cloud                                  |
|               7 | Fire Shield, Wall of Fire                                 |
|               9 | Geas, Insect Plague                                       |
